data.value: A firewall rule applies to TCP or to UDP.

data.name: RuleSourceCidrInvalid
data.value: The source range must be written in CIDR notation, with no host bits beyond the prefix.

data.name: BanAddressInvalid
data.value: This is not an address the firewall can ban.

data.name: BanAddressLoopback
data.value: A loopback address cannot be banned: this host accepts loopback traffic before any ban is consulted, so the ban would block nothing. Ban the address the traffic reaches this server from instead — the one shown for the connection, not 127.0.0.1 or ::1.

data.name: BanDurationInvalid
data.value: A ban lasts between one minute and one year; leave the duration empty for a permanent ban.

data.name: BanNotFound
data.value: No ban is in force for this address.

data.value: The range must be written in CIDR notation, with no host bits beyond the prefix.

data.name: WhitelistCidrTaken
data.value: This range is already on the whitelist.

data.name: WhitelistEntryNotFound
data.value: This whitelist entry could not be found.

data.name: WhitelistEntryProtectsCaller
data.value: Removing this range would stop exempting the address you are connected from, and a mistyped password could then lock you out of this server. Add an exemption that also covers this address and remove this one afterwards, or remove it while connected from another address.
